messages.subject: troubleshhoting_CODEX_number_of_samples
parts:
Hello Yuchao,

I am trying to use CODEX for CNV detection. Does the package work when processing only two samples? I get RSS values equal to 0 and I do not get any calls. Can you explain why is that happening and what is the minimum number of samples tha can be used in order to get reasonable results?

Thank you,

Athina

messages.author: 94ec915e8ce36448
messages.subject: Re: troubleshhoting_CODEX_number_of_samples
parts:
Hi Athina,

CODEX adopts a multi-sample normalization procedure which estimates the GC content, targeting and amplification efficiency, and latent biases and artifacts across samples. 2 samples aren’t enough. You would probably need at least 10-20 samples go obtain good performance.

Yuchao
